name: ada-harness
description: Plantilla mínima de un AI Harness: capas de contexto, loop agéntico, compactación y subagentes, con un chat minimalista. Funciona con Claude, Gemini y modelos locales con Ollama.

scripts.start: npm run build && node bin/ada.js serve
scripts.cli: npm run build && node bin/ada.js run
scripts.capas: npm run build && node bin/ada.js capas
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node tests/run.js unit
scripts.test:providers: npm run build && node tests/run.js providers
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node tests/run.js integration
